!* Features
[[ Top ][#content]]
!anchor features
!4 '''Features'''

A feature is something a Circle can have beside its files, such as a chat or a calendar (see FEATURES.md). !-EDS-! doesn't know what a
feature is for: a feature is a declaration, which names the kinds of its entries and, for each kind, rules from a fixed set. !-EDS-!
stores the entries and enforces the rules; what an entry holds is the clients' business. The operations are part of the
Resource API, and are named by their operationId in the API contract.

 * Features of the stone - ${REST_ROOT}/features (GET), ${REST_ROOT}/features/{feature} (PUT, DELETE)
 * Features of a Circle - ${REST_ROOT}/circles/{circleId}/features (GET), ${REST_ROOT}/circles/{circleId}/features/{feature} (PUT, DELETE)
 * Entries - ${REST_ROOT}/circles/{circleId}/features/{feature}/entries (GET, POST), .../entries/{entryId} (GET, PUT, DELETE), .../entries/{entryId}/closed (PUT), .../count (GET)

|process member                                                     |
|account name|credential         |action|new credential|return code?|
|admin       |${ADMIN_PASSPHRASE}|LOGIN |tadmin_session|${SUCCESS}  |
|user1       |${PASSPHRASE_1}    |LOGIN |t1_session    |${SUCCESS}  |
|user2       |${PASSPHRASE_2}    |LOGIN |t2_session    |${SUCCESS}  |
|user3       |${PASSPHRASE_3}    |LOGIN |t3_session    |${SUCCESS}  |

The System Administrator decides which features the stone offers. This one keeps notes, which their author changes and the
administrators of a Circle close, and votes about notes, of which every Member has one per note. Every Member may read
what the stone offers.

|features                                                                                           |
|credential    |operation|feature |declaration|status?|return code?            |features?    |
|t1_session    |putFeature  |notes|!-{"feature":"notes","version":1,"kinds":{"note":{"add":"WRITE","change":["author"],"remove":["author"],"close":["administrators"],"size":1000},"vote":{"add":"READ","change":["author"],"about":"note","keep":"member-about","size":10}}}-!|401    |${AUTHORIZATION_WARNING}|[]        |
|tadmin_session|putFeature  |notes|!-{"feature":"notes"}-!|406|${VERIFICATION_WARNING}|[]    |
|tadmin_session|putFeature  |notes|!-{"feature":"notes","version":1,"kinds":{"note":{"add":"WRITE","change":["author"],"remove":["author"],"close":["administrators"],"size":1000},"vote":{"add":"READ","change":["author"],"about":"note","keep":"member-about","size":10}}}-!|200    |${SUCCESS}              |[notes:v1]|
|t3_session    |getFeatures |null |null       |200    |${SUCCESS}              |[notes:v1]|

The Member user1 creates a Circle; user2 may write to it, user3 may only read it. As its administrator, user1 switches the
feature on, which makes its hidden folder ''.notes''.

|resources                                                                                               |
|credential|operation         |circle id  |member id|name     |trust level|new key |status?|return code?|
|t1_session|postCircles       |null       |null     |feature room|null       |featureroom|200    |${SUCCESS}  |
|t1_session|postCircleTrustees|featureroom_id|user2_id |null     |WRITE      |null    |200    |${SUCCESS}  |
|t1_session|postCircleTrustees|featureroom_id|user3_id |null     |READ       |null    |200    |${SUCCESS}  |

|features                                                                                        |
|credential|operation     |circle id  |feature |state|status?|return code?            |features?    |
|t2_session|putCircleFeature |featureroom_id|notes|ON   |401    |${AUTHORIZATION_WARNING}|[]        |
|t1_session|putCircleFeature |featureroom_id|notes|ON   |200    |${SUCCESS}              |[notes:ON]|
|t3_session|getCircleFeatures|featureroom_id|null |null |200    |${SUCCESS}              |[notes:ON]|

Entries are added by those the kind allows: a note needs the trust level WRITE, a vote only READ. !-EDS-! notes the author. A
second vote of a Member about the same note replaces the first. Only its author changes a note, and what is about an entry
is listed and counted.

|features                                                                                                                                                                     |
|credential|operation    |circle id  |feature |kind|about   |entry id|content       |new key|status?|return code?            |entries?                                                |count?|
|t2_session|postEntry    |featureroom_id|notes|note|null    |null    |Buy bread     |bread  |200    |${SUCCESS}              |[note:user2:Buy bread]                                  |null  |
|t3_session|postEntry    |featureroom_id|notes|note|null    |null    |Not for me    |null   |401    |${AUTHORIZATION_WARNING}|[]                                                      |null  |
|t3_session|postEntry    |featureroom_id|notes|vote|null    |null    |yes           |null   |406    |${VERIFICATION_WARNING} |[]                                                      |null  |
|t3_session|postEntry    |featureroom_id|notes|vote|bread_id|null    |yes           |null   |200    |${SUCCESS}              |[vote:user3:yes]                                        |null  |
|t3_session|postEntry    |featureroom_id|notes|vote|bread_id|null    |no            |null   |200    |${SUCCESS}              |[vote:user3:no:changed]                                 |null  |
|t1_session|putEntry     |featureroom_id|notes|null|null    |bread_id|Not by another|null   |401    |${AUTHORIZATION_WARNING}|[]                                                      |null  |
|t2_session|putEntry     |featureroom_id|notes|null|null    |bread_id|Buy two breads|null   |200    |${SUCCESS}              |[note:user2:Buy two breads:changed]                     |null  |
|t1_session|getEntries   |featureroom_id|notes|null|null    |null    |null          |null   |200    |${SUCCESS}              |[note:user2:Buy two breads:changed, vote:user3:no:changed]|null|
|t1_session|getEntries   |featureroom_id|notes|null|bread_id|null    |null          |null   |200    |${SUCCESS}              |[vote:user3:no:changed]                                 |null  |
|t1_session|getEntryCount|featureroom_id|notes|vote|null    |null    |null          |null   |200    |${SUCCESS}              |null                                                    |1     |

A closed entry stays as it is, with what is about it, until it is opened again. Removing an entry removes what is about it.

|features                                                                                                                                                    |
|credential|operation     |circle id  |feature |about   |entry id|content |closed|status?|return code?            |entries?                                        |
|t2_session|putEntryClosed|featureroom_id|notes|null    |bread_id|null    |true  |401    |${AUTHORIZATION_WARNING}|[]                                              |
|t1_session|putEntryClosed|featureroom_id|notes|null    |bread_id|null    |true  |200    |${SUCCESS}              |[note:user2:Buy two breads:closed:changed]      |
|t2_session|putEntry      |featureroom_id|notes|null    |bread_id|Too late|null  |405    |${ILLEGAL_ACTION}       |[]                                              |
|t1_session|putEntryClosed|featureroom_id|notes|null    |bread_id|null    |false |200    |${SUCCESS}              |[note:user2:Buy two breads:changed]             |
|t2_session|deleteEntry   |featureroom_id|notes|null    |bread_id|null    |null  |200    |${SUCCESS}              |[note:user2:-:changed, vote:user3:-:changed]    |
|t1_session|getEntries    |featureroom_id|notes|null    |null    |null    |null  |200    |${SUCCESS}              |[]                                              |

Switched off, a feature keeps its entries and hides them. Removing it from the Circle removes them; then the stone can stop
offering it. At the end, the Circle is deleted.

|features                                                                                              |
|credential    |operation       |circle id  |feature |state|status?|return code?             |features?     |
|t1_session    |putCircleFeature   |featureroom_id|notes|OFF  |200    |${SUCCESS}               |[notes:OFF]|
|t2_session    |getEntries      |featureroom_id|notes|null |404    |${IDENTIFICATION_WARNING}|null       |
|tadmin_session|deleteFeature      |null       |notes|null |405    |${ILLEGAL_ACTION}        |[]         |
|t1_session    |deleteCircleFeature|featureroom_id|notes|null |200    |${SUCCESS}               |[]         |
|tadmin_session|deleteFeature      |null       |notes|null |200    |${SUCCESS}               |[]         |
|tadmin_session|getFeatures        |null       |null |null |200    |${SUCCESS}               |[]         |

|resources                                                                 |
|credential|operation       |circle id  |status?|return code?|
|t1_session|deleteCircleById|featureroom_id|200    |${SUCCESS}  |
*!
